C0438.title: US Jewelry Retailer Hit by Carding Attack, Facing Payment Gateway Blacklist Risk
C0438.summary: A US jewelry retailer suffered a sustained carding attack where attackers used multiple browser-simulated bots to attempt purchases with stolen or fake credit card details and randomly generated email addresses. Although the orders were unsuccessful, the high volume of fraudulent transactions put the merchant at risk of being blacklisted by its third-party payment provider, potentially leading to
